title: Why the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project has been contentious | Explained

ai.summary: The Adi community and activists protested against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh, with groups rejecting the Arunachal government's offer of talks on November 5.

facts.claim: The proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh has triggered protests by the Adi community, and activists have been arrested or detained since October.
facts.quote: The proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh has triggered protests by the Adi community, and activists have been arrested or detained since October.

facts.claim: Protesting groups rejected the Arunachal government's offer of talks on November 5.
facts.quote: Protesting groups rejected the Arunachal government's offer of talks on November 5.

ai.background_note: The Siang Indigenous Farmers' Forum opposes a proposed mega dam on the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh, which has led to protests and detentions.
